<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.35"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#121826"/>

  <!-- iPhone status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="18" font-family="Roboto Mono" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="318" y1="12" x2="322" y2="12" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="318" y1="15" x2="326" y2="15" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="318" y1="18" x2="330" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="343" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="339" y1="19" x2="347" y2="19" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="356" y="9" width="21" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="359" y="12" width="14" height="5" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="378" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,52 23,60 31,68" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="60" x2="43" y2="60" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Wallet setup</text>
    <circle cx="362" cy="60" r="14" fill="#35383F"/>
    <circle cx="362" cy="56" r="3.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <ellipse cx="362" cy="65" rx="6" ry="3.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Decorative celebration field -->
  <g opacity="0.9">
    <circle cx="195" cy="232" r="116" fill="#8B232359"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="232" r="91" fill="#990000" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="232" r="70" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="232" r="59" fill="#990000"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="132" x2="195" y2="112" stroke="#FEC949" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="332" x2="195" y2="352" stroke="#FEC949" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="95" y1="232" x2="75" y2="232" stroke="#FEC949" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="295" y1="232" x2="315" y2="232" stroke="#FEC949" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="124" y1="161" x2="110" y2="147" stroke="#F55F5F" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="266" y1="303" x2="280" y2="317" stroke="#F55F5F" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="266" y1="161" x2="280" y2="147" stroke="#F55F5F" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="124" y1="303" x2="110" y2="317" stroke="#F55F5F" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <polygon points="107,188 112,199 124,200 115,207 118,219 107,213 96,219 99,207 90,200 102,199" fill="#FEC949"/>
    <polygon points="284,260 289,271 301,272 292,279 295,291 284,285 273,291 276,279 267,272 279,271" fill="#FEC949"/>
    <circle cx="91" cy="265" r="5" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
    <circle cx="302" cy="193" r="5" fill="#F8A0A0"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Wallet success icon -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="151" y="190" width="88" height="70" rx="15" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="161" y="201" width="67" height="48" rx="10" fill="#FCE3E3"/>
    <rect x="201" y="213" width="34" height="25" rx="7" fill="#990000"/>
    <circle cx="218" cy="225" r="4" fill="#FEC949"/>
    <polyline points="171,227 181,237 197,215" fill="none" stroke="#990000" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Confirmation copy -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="394" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="32" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Congratulations!</text>
    <text x="195" y="425" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto Mono" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">Your wallet is ready to use.</text>
    <text x="195" y="448" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto Mono" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">You can now pay for every ride.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Wallet details card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="480" width="340" height="112" rx="20" fill="#000000" opacity="0.28"/>
    <rect x="25" y="476" width="340" height="112" rx="20" fill="#212121" stroke="#35383F" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="514" r="21" fill="#990000"/>
    <rect x="47" y="506" width="20" height="14" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="62" cy="513" r="2.5" fill="#990000"/>
    <text x="91" y="510" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Tirana travel wallet</text>
    <text x="91" y="535" font-family="Roboto Mono" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#C4C4C4">Wallet ID  •••• 4821</text>
    <line x1="45" y1="554" x2="345" y2="554" stroke="#35383F" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="45" y="576" font-family="Roboto Mono" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#C4C4C4">STATUS</text>
    <rect x="286" y="562" width="59" height="22" rx="11" fill="#8B232359"/>
    <circle cx="299" cy="573" r="4" fill="#FEC949"/>
    <text x="307" y="577" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Active</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Actions -->
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="620" width="340" height="54" rx="20" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
    <text x="195" y="654" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Start riding</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="686" width="340" height="48" rx="20" fill="#35383F"/>
    <text x="195" y="716" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">View wallet details</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="764" width="390" height="80" fill="#181A20"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="764" x2="390" y2="764" stroke="#35383F" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="48,790 58,782 68,790 68,802 62,802 62,794 54,794 54,802 48,802" fill="#6C6C6C"/>
    <text x="58" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6C6C6C">Home</text>
    <!-- Routes -->
    <circle cx="146" cy="790" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="146" cy="790" r="2.5" fill="#6C6C6C"/>
    <line x1="146" y1="778" x2="146" y2="782" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="146" y1="798" x2="146" y2="802" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="146" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6C6C6C">Routes</text>
    <!-- Wallet selected -->
    <rect x="218" y="781" width="25" height="18" rx="4" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
    <rect x="224" y="785" width="23" height="12" rx="3" fill="#FF4D4D" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="238" cy="791" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="231" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FF4D4D">Wallet</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="330" cy="786" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="330" cy="799" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="330" y="823" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#6C6C6C">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
